files.name: GridKey.java

tests.name: Equality matrix
tests.description: Compare one object to itself, two distinct equal keys, a third equal key, keys differing in either field, null and a String.
tests.expected: The first equal-coordinate cases are true; differing fields, null and unrelated types are false.

tests.name: Hash collection and collision
tests.description: Add (0,31), an equal copy and (1,0) to a HashSet using hash = 31*row+column.
tests.expected: Size 2; the two unequal keys collide at hash 31 without becoming equal.

reasoning: A final class makes the chosen equality domain explicit: subclasses cannot add equality-relevant state. Each equality comparison uses the same two immutable fields.
Both (0,31) and (1,0) hash to 31. Their different coordinates keep equals false. A HashSet uses equality as well as hashing.
